name: Washing Machine
description:
A household of three (turning four) is seeking for a donated washing machine. The family comprises of a young married couple (both aged 24), their 1-year-old son, and will be expecting a newborn in a month's time - Oct 2026. In hopes to provide a stable environment for their growing family, the couple have secured their first home - a 2-room public rental flat in Yishun. They have mainly been lodging with relatives prior, without a proper space of their own. As the wife is currently unable to work due to her pregnancy and the need to care for their young son, the family relies solely on the husband's limited income. They have been preparing for the move mostly by sourcing for second-hand furniture. The only remaining item that they have challenges obtaining is a washing machine, due to their limited budget. A washing machine will greatly alleviate some of their daily household chores, thereby freeing up more capacity for them to focus on settling down into their new home and the arrival of their newborn in the coming month. This will also support the young family's fresh start as a unit of four in their new home.
The family is hoping to move and settle into their new home within Sep 2026, to ensure a proper space is ready by the time of their newborn's arrival. They will hence benefit from a donated, well-functioning washing machine the soonest.
